floors.name: F_MainCorridor
floors.note: The south end of the main spine; the entrance is at its south edge.

floors.name: F_PostOpRecovery
floors.note: Bottom-left room. The entrance apron is immediately to its east.

floors.name: F_RecoveryRoom
floors.note: Bottom-right, immediately east of the main spine.

floors.name: F_WasteDisposal
floors.note: Immediately east of Recovery. Its south and north edges align with Recovery.

floors.name: F_StaffRoom
floors.note: Above Waste, to the right of the elevator lobby. This is the lower Staff Room, not the small top Staff utility room.

floors.name: F_Storage
floors.note: Above Staff Room. The right edges align; Storage extends farther left, as in the drawing.

floors.name: F_Elevator
floors.note: Central-right shaft footprint. Its entrance faces south into the elevator lobby.

floors.name: F_EntranceApron
floors.note: Fills the strip between Post-op and the lower main corridor.

floors.name: F_ElevatorLobby
floors.note: Connects the main corridor, Recovery, elevator entrance and lower Staff Room. This replaces the old conflicting corridor concept with an explicitly bounded lobby.

floors.name: F_ElevatorServiceStrip
floors.note: The narrow strip beside the elevator is enclosed service space, not a through-corridor.

floors.name: F_WestLowerHall
floors.note: Passage below the Office and above Post-op; joins the main spine on its east edge.

floors.name: F_GeneralWard
floors.note: Left of the Office and west lower hall; below the west cross-corridor.

floors.name: F_NurseOffice
floors.note: Immediately right of the General Ward. Its east side makes the main passage narrower here.

floors.name: F_MainCorridor_Office
floors.note: Main passage alongside the Office. Do not extend the previous corridor cube through the Office.

floors.name: F_MainCorridor_Middle
floors.note: Connects the Office segment to the wider upper corridor.

floors.name: F_WestCrossCorridor
floors.note: The long horizontal corridor between General Ward/Office and Anaesthesia Prep.

floors.name: F_RightLanding
floors.note: Above the elevator and below the stair footprint; leads to Storage.

floors.name: F_StairFootprint
floors.note: Preserves the staircase location. This prototype encloses it; do not build an upper floor or traversable stairs.

floors.name: F_PreOpApproach
floors.note: Passage east of the enclosed stairs. Joins the right landing and the Pre-op entrance.

floors.name: F_PreOp
floors.note: Above Storage and below Sterile Core.

floors.name: F_AnaesthesiaPrep
floors.note: Above the west cross-corridor and below Operating Room 1.

floors.name: F_WashroomAlcove
floors.note: The unlabeled washroom/service area drawn east of Anaesthesia. No fixtures are added.

floors.name: F_OperatingApproach
floors.note: Short east-west connector between Anaesthesia, the washroom alcove and the main spine.

floors.name: F_OperatingDoorRecess
floors.note: The northward recess at Operating Room 1's doorway.

floors.name: F_OperatingApproachReturn
floors.note: Completes the connector beside the Operating doorway recess.

floors.name: F_MainCorridor_Upper
floors.note: Wider central passage west of Sterile Core.

floors.name: F_SterileCore
floors.note: Below ICU/Diagnostics and above Pre-op.

floors.name: F_SterileCore_SouthNotch
floors.note: Small extension at Sterile Core's southwest corner. This is part of the same room; do not wall its seam.

floors.name: F_OperatingRoom1
floors.note: Main west portion of Operating Room 1.

floors.name: F_OperatingRoom1_East
floors.note: East portion of the same Operating Room, above its doorway recess.

floors.name: F_OperatingRoom1_North
floors.note: Raised outline on the north edge of Operating Room 1. All three slabs form one continuous room.

floors.name: F_OperatingServiceShaft
floors.note: Simplified enclosed equipment/shaft strip between Operating Room and the main corridor.

floors.name: F_MainCorridor_North
floors.note: Northward corridor leading toward WC and upper Staff utility room.

floors.name: F_NorthLobby
floors.note: Wider top lobby directly below WC and the small Staff room.

floors.name: F_NorthServiceAlcove
floors.note: Small enclosed service recess west of the north lobby. Treat its ambiguous interior symbols as a closed footprint in this first blockout.

floors.name: F_WC
floors.note: Small top-left WC; its door faces the north lobby.

floors.name: F_StaffUtility
floors.note: Small top Staff utility room, distinct from the large lower Staff Room.

floors.name: F_ICUTreatment
floors.note: ICU lower portion, above Sterile Core and left of Diagnostics.

floors.name: F_ICUTreatment_North
floors.note: ICU upper extension beside the Staff utility room. No wall across the seam.

floors.name: F_DiagnosticsTests
floors.note: Top-right room. Its north edge is lower than ICU's, matching the stepped silhouette.

objects.name: F_Storage
objects.info: Above Staff Room. The right edges align; Storage extends farther left, as in the drawing.

objects.name: F_Elevator
objects.info: Central-right shaft footprint. Its entrance faces south into the elevator lobby.

objects.name: F_EntranceApron
objects.info: Fills the strip between Post-op and the lower main corridor.

objects.name: F_ElevatorLobby
objects.info: Connects the main corridor, Recovery, elevator entrance and lower Staff Room. This replaces the old conflicting corridor concept with an explicitly bounded lobby.

objects.name: F_ElevatorServiceStrip
objects.info: The narrow strip beside the elevator is enclosed service space, not a through-corridor.

objects.name: F_WestLowerHall
objects.info: Passage below the Office and above Post-op; joins the main spine on its east edge.

objects.name: F_GeneralWard
objects.info: Left of the Office and west lower hall; below the west cross-corridor.

objects.name: F_NurseOffice
objects.info: Immediately right of the General Ward. Its east side makes the main passage narrower here.

objects.name: F_MainCorridor_Office
objects.info: Main passage alongside the Office. Do not extend the previous corridor cube through the Office.

objects.name: F_MainCorridor_Middle
objects.info: Connects the Office segment to the wider upper corridor.

objects.name: F_WestCrossCorridor
objects.info: The long horizontal corridor between General Ward/Office and Anaesthesia Prep.

objects.name: F_RightLanding
objects.info: Above the elevator and below the stair footprint; leads to Storage.

objects.name: F_StairFootprint
objects.info: Preserves the staircase location. This prototype encloses it; do not build an upper floor or traversable stairs.

objects.name: F_PreOpApproach
objects.info: Passage east of the enclosed stairs. Joins the right landing and the Pre-op entrance.

objects.name: F_PreOp
objects.info: Above Storage and below Sterile Core.

objects.name: F_AnaesthesiaPrep
objects.info: Above the west cross-corridor and below Operating Room 1.

objects.name: F_WashroomAlcove
objects.info: The unlabeled washroom/service area drawn east of Anaesthesia. No fixtures are added.

objects.name: F_OperatingApproach
objects.info: Short east-west connector between Anaesthesia, the washroom alcove and the main spine.

objects.name: F_OperatingDoorRecess
objects.info: The northward recess at Operating Room 1's doorway.

objects.name: F_OperatingApproachReturn
objects.info: Completes the connector beside the Operating doorway recess.

objects.name: F_MainCorridor_Upper
objects.info: Wider central passage west of Sterile Core.

objects.name: F_SterileCore
objects.info: Below ICU/Diagnostics and above Pre-op.

objects.name: F_SterileCore_SouthNotch
objects.info: Small extension at Sterile Core's southwest corner. This is part of the same room; do not wall its seam.

objects.name: F_OperatingRoom1
objects.info: Main west portion of Operating Room 1.

objects.name: F_OperatingRoom1_East
objects.info: East portion of the same Operating Room, above its doorway recess.

objects.name: F_OperatingRoom1_North
objects.info: Raised outline on the north edge of Operating Room 1. All three slabs form one continuous room.

objects.name: F_OperatingServiceShaft
objects.info: Simplified enclosed equipment/shaft strip between Operating Room and the main corridor.

objects.name: F_MainCorridor_North
objects.info: Northward corridor leading toward WC and upper Staff utility room.

objects.name: F_NorthLobby
objects.info: Wider top lobby directly below WC and the small Staff room.

objects.name: F_NorthServiceAlcove
objects.info: Small enclosed service recess west of the north lobby. Treat its ambiguous interior symbols as a closed footprint in this first blockout.

objects.name: F_WC
objects.info: Small top-left WC; its door faces the north lobby.

objects.name: F_StaffUtility
objects.info: Small top Staff utility room, distinct from the large lower Staff Room.

objects.name: F_ICUTreatment
objects.info: ICU lower portion, above Sterile Core and left of Diagnostics.

objects.name: F_ICUTreatment_North
objects.info: ICU upper extension beside the Staff utility room. No wall across the seam.

objects.name: F_DiagnosticsTests
objects.info: Top-right room. Its north edge is lower than ICU's, matching the stepped silhouette.

objects.name: D_MainEntrance_Leaf
objects.info: South main entrance. Closed placeholder for the one-exit prototype.

objects.name: D_PostOp_Leaf
objects.info: North side of Post-op, opening into the lower west hall.

objects.name: D_Ward_PostOp_Leaf
objects.info: Door drawn at the northwest of Post-op into the Ward.

objects.name: D_Recovery_Leaf
objects.info: Recovery opens north into the elevator lobby.

objects.name: D_Waste_Leaf
objects.info: Waste is reached from the Staff Room, as the drawn north doorway indicates.

objects.name: D_StaffRoom_Leaf
objects.info: West side of Staff Room, facing the elevator lobby.

objects.name: D_Elevator_Leaf
objects.info: South elevator opening. Closed placeholder; keypad and unlock behavior belong to later gameplay work.

objects.name: D_Storage_Leaf
objects.info: West side of Storage, facing the landing above the elevator.

objects.name: D_Ward_North_Leaf
objects.info: North Ward doorway off the west cross-corridor.

objects.name: D_Ward_East_Leaf
objects.info: Lower east Ward doorway into the lower west hall.

objects.name: D_Office_North_Leaf
objects.info: Office entrance on its north edge.

objects.name: D_Office_South_Leaf
objects.info: Second Office entrance into the lower west hall.

objects.name: D_PreOp_Leaf
objects.info: Pre-op door faces the passage east of the stair enclosure.

objects.name: D_Anaesthesia_Leaf
objects.info: Upper east side of Anaesthesia, opening toward the Operating approach.

objects.name: D_Washroom_Leaf
objects.info: Door on the north side of the unlabeled washroom.

objects.name: D_Operating_Leaf
objects.info: Operating Room door faces south into its recessed approach.

objects.name: D_Sterile_West_Leaf
objects.info: West side of Sterile Core, facing the wide main corridor.

objects.name: D_ICU_Sterile_Leaf
objects.info: Connection drawn between ICU and Sterile Core.

objects.name: D_ICU_West_Leaf
objects.info: Upper west ICU doorway into the north lobby.

objects.name: D_Diagnostics_Leaf
objects.info: Diagnostics opens west into ICU; no invented corridor through ICU.

objects.name: D_WC_Leaf
objects.info: WC door faces south into the north lobby.

objects.name: D_StaffUtility_Leaf
objects.info: Small Staff utility door faces south into the north lobby.
